scope: Targeted supplementary publisher discovery for AI reward hacking. Query results are relevance-ranked. Screened titles for explicit references to reward hacking, tampering, misspecification, wireheading, specification gaming or reward-model overoptimization. Checked date, title overlap with arXiv and author or identifier where available. No language limit. Bibliographic metadata from Crossref, supplemented by publisher bibliographies and Semantic Scholar for cited-work details. An absent title match does not rule out a renamed preprint.
